::: {#exr-receptive-field}

#### What one output can see

`two_convs` below stacks two `nn.Conv2d(1, 1, 3, padding=1)` layers.
Which pixels of an $8 \times 8$ input can change the output in row 4, column 4?
Count rows and columns from 0.

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
_ = torch.manual_seed(1)
two_convs = nn.Sequential(
    nn.Conv2d(1, 1, 3, padding=1),
    nn.Conv2d(1, 1, 3, padding=1),
)
print(two_convs)
```

:::
